messages.subject: Help in understanding compilation errors
parts:
Hi,

I'm getting compilation errors (also attached as rstan,ERR.txt) I cannot really begin to understand:
Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! icpc: command line warning #10120: overriding '-O3' with '-O2'
filefa14a364e8.cpp(159): warning #1125: function "stan::model::prob_grad::log_prob(std::vector<double, std::allocator<double>> &, std::vector<int, std::allocator<int>> &, std::ostream *)" is hidden by "modelfa170f6f0e2_model_namespace::modelfa170f6f0e2_model::log_prob" -- virtual function override intended?

          ^

/n/sw/R-2.15.2/lib64/R/library/rstan/include//stansrc/stan/math/error_handling.hpp(340): error: no operator ">=" matches these operands
            operand types are: const modelfa170f6f0e2_model_namespace::matrix_d >= int
              if (!(y >= low_vec[n]))
                      ^

            instantiation of "bool stan::math::<unnamed>::greater_or_equal<T_y, T_low, T_result, Policy, is_vec>::check(const char *, const T_y &, const T_low &, const char *, T_result *, const P
Calls: stan ... stan_model -> cxxfunctionplus -> cxxfunction -> compileCode

My model (also attached as model.stan.txt) is:
data {
  int<lower=1> G; // number of groups
  int<lower=1> S; // number of subgroups
  int<lower=1> kMax; // maximal number of subgroup observations
  matrix<lower=-1,upper=1>[S,kMax] O[G];
}
parameters {
  //real<lower=0> muGroupSubgroup; 
  real muGroupSubgroup;
  //real<lower=0> sigmaSquaredGroupSubgroup;
  real sigmaSquaredGroupSubgroup;
  real cGroup;
  real dGroup;
}
transformed parameters {
  real alphaGroupSubgroup; 
  real betaGroupSubgroup;
  alphaGroupSubgroup <- -1*muGroupSubgroup*(sigmaSquaredGroupSubgroup + muGroupSubgroup*muGroupSubgroup - muGroupSubgroup)/sigmaSquaredGroupSubgroup;
  betaGroupSubgroup <- (sigmaSquaredGroupSubgroup + muGroupSubgroup*muGroupSubgroup - muGroupSubgroup)*(muGroupSubgroup - 1)/sigmaSquaredGroupSubgroup; 
}
model {
  //priors
  muGroupSubgroup ~ beta(1,1);
  sigmaSquaredGroupSubgroup ~ gamma(cGroup,dGroup);
  cGroup ~ exponential(1);
  dGroup ~ exponential(1);
  //sampling   
  for (g in 1:G){
for (s in 1:S){
for (k in 1:kMax){
if(O[g,s,k] != -1){
O[g,s,k] ~ beta(alphaGroupSubgroup,betaGroupSubgroup);
}
}
}
  }
}
